text: Hold still for a moment!
Now we can talk.

Ah it's you again.
What do you want?
zh:
啊，又是你。
你想要什么？

text: Who are you?
What are you doing?
Here is the swamp secretion.
Do you need something else?
I will bring you the heart of a warrior.
zh: 我会给你带来战士之心。

text: Regarding the heart...
See you.
No one around here has a name, except our leader.
zh: 这里的人都没有名字，除了我们的领袖。

text: That is a confusing rule, if you ask me.
zh: 要我说，这规矩挺让人费解的。

text: Is there anything else you want to know?
The secretion itself may contain healing substances, which we don't know yet.
zh: 这种分泌物本身可能含有我们尚不了解的治愈成分。

text: I am searching for a way to extract the poison out of the swamp secretion.
zh: 我在寻找从沼泽分泌物中提取毒素的方法。

text: Sure!
You don't happen to have a phial of secretion on you?
zh: 你身上不会正好带着一小瓶分泌物吧？

text: Here, take this secretion.
No.

Well, well, well.
Exactly what I needed.
zh:
好，好，好。
正是我需要的。

text: Why are we still wasting time?
zh: 那我们还在浪费什么时间？

text: Get me a phial of swamp secretion.
zh: 去给我弄一瓶沼泽分泌物来。

text: Indeed!
A while ago we had a visitor offering the #:heart of a warrior:#.
zh: 前阵子有位访客来兜售一颗#:战士之心:#。

text: This seemed to be a rare find among the orcs in the wasteland.
zh: 这在荒地的兽人当中似乎是件稀罕物。

text:
For whatever reason I declined the offer.
However, I can't stop thinking about the heart.
zh:
不知怎的，我当时拒绝了。
可如今我满脑子都是那颗心。

text: Just think of the secrets that such a heart holds.
zh: 想想看，那样一颗心里藏着多少秘密。

text: Bring me one #:heart of a warrior:# for my research.
zh: 给我带一颗#:战士之心:#来供我研究。

text: Sure.
Where do I find such a heart?
zh: 我上哪儿找这样一颗心？

text: Who was the visitor?
I need to think about it.

I think his name started with a "G".
Or was it a "D"?
zh:
我记得他的名字是“G”开头的。
还是“D”来着？

text: Could have been an "L" or "M" as well...

Argh...
I don't know.
Excellent!
Now go and bring me the heart.
zh: 现在去吧，把那颗心带来。

text: Unless you find the visitor to get the heart, you will need to go to the wasteland.
zh: 除非你能找到那位访客拿到心，否则你就得去荒地跑一趟。

text: I am sure one of the orcs has the heart of a warrior.
zh: 我敢肯定，某个兽人身上就有战士之心。

text: That's unfortunate.
Did you find a heart already?
Here is the heart of a warrior.
Here is the heart of a warrior (poisoned).
Where do I find such a heart?
zh: 我上哪儿找这样一颗心？

text: I still need to find one.
Then don't waste any time.
That is the heart of a warrior?
Incredible!
I'll need some time for my experiments.
zh: 我需要些时间来做实验。

text: Here, take these potions for your effort!
zh: 来，这些药水就当谢礼了！

text: Unless you find the visitor to get the heart, you will need to got to the wasteland.
zh: 除非你能找到那位访客拿到心，否则你就得去荒地跑一趟。
